description: MultiKendall: T=8 weightless partial-order tables (NAP=48 pairs each), per-table Kendall tau between predicted e_hat (residual->E=64) and tied vocab embeddings, AGGREGATED by a small shared MLP (8->16->1) instead of summed. Sum would collapse to the flat K=384 head (~+0.25 plateau); the MLP makes the tables matter (nonlinear aggregation = the lever the flat sum can't reach). Tied codes, hard popcount per table, V-chunked+checkpointed. vs exp551 flat Kendall K=384 (~1.94@1600, ~+0.25 plateau), exp513 Linear 1.4825/1.4656.
